title: Forest Spirit Magic
description: Step into a whimsical enchanted forest—cast cozy spells, gather glowing acorns, and solve charming woodland puzzles with magical companions.
controls: Tap magical tiles and forest companions to trigger combos and clear every enchanted stage.

zh-CN.title: 森林魔法物语
zh-CN.description: 吉卜力风治愈奇幻森林魔法物语：携手呆萌森林精灵施展魔法、收集闪亮松果与宝物，开启梦幻林间物语！
zh-CN.controls: 点击屏幕触发魔法消除与精灵技能，完成奇幻森林各关冒险目标。
